thread:
maria_pm: Quick heads-up — NimbusKey asked to coordinate a joint marketplace listing + HSM-backed KMS connector launch. They want SSO (SAML) + SCIM provision in the same go.
diego_partners: Nice. Do we have existing connector docs that match NimbusKey's requirements (they listed Thales Luna SA and PKCS#11)?
noah_ops: We have a generic HSM connector guide but not a NimbusKey-specific playbook. Will need an example PKCS#11 config and a diagram.
ellen_sec: Security note: we can support PKCS#11 keywrap if the partner uses FIPS 140-2/3 validated modules. We should avoid showing internal KMS endpoints; provide an integration pattern diagram instead.
maria_pm: Good. NimbusKey's partner brief also asks for signed SAML assertions, SP-initiated only, and SCIM group push for roles `researchers` and `ml-platform`. Can our SCIM support those groups?
noah_ops: Yes, enterprise SCIM supports group push. I can prepare a sample mapping and a curl example to push groups.
diego_partners: Timeline they requested: submission to marketplace by 2028-04-12, embargo lift planned for 2028-04-26. Marketing wants final assets a week before.
tara_marketing: We'll need at least a 400-char marketplace description, 2 screenshots, and an optional 20-30s demo clip. Can engineering produce a sanitized GIF of onboarding?
noah_ops: We can record a demo from staging. I'll redact org names and user emails. Prefer to show just the SSO button + successful group sync.
ellen_sec: Also confirm rotation cadence — NimbusKey requests 60-day cert rotation and prefers SHA-256. We'll include a sample cron for cert rotation and steps to generate new X.509 signing certs.
maria_pm: Diego, can you confirm whether NimbusKey wants us to claim "HSM-backed keywrap" on the listing? That may require approvals from security/compliance.
diego_partners: On their side, yes. They asked to call out "HSM-backed customer keywrap (FIPS validated)" in the blurb. Ellen, approve?
ellen_sec: We can approve language: "Supports HSM-backed key wrapping using customer-managed FIPS-validated modules." Do not list vendor-specific endpoints or internal IPs.
tara_marketing: Draft blurb suggestion: "Redwood + NimbusKey: enterprise inference with optional customer-managed HSM keywrap, SSO (SAML) and SCIM provisioning." Need one sentence that's a little more marketing-friendly for the tile.
maria_pm: Add note about private deployments (VPC) being supported. Partners like that for regulated customers.
diego_partners: I'll chase NimbusKey PM for a staging SP and a test org. Need test accounts to validate SAML flows and group sync. ETA EOD for their reply.
noah_ops: I'll prepare an integration test checklist: SAML metadata import, SP-init test, signed assertion validation, SCIM group push + delta provisioning, HSM keywrap validation.
tara_marketing: Also attach two screenshots: (1) SSO success page with redacted email, (2) console showing key configuration (values redacted). Marketplace requires 1280x720 or similar.
marketplace_bot: Reminder: marketplace schema requires `short_description` (max 100 chars), `long_description` (min 300 chars), icons (PNG), and compliance badges if claiming FIPS. See https://marketplace.example/guide.
maria_pm: OK team, sync scheduled Thursday 09:30 to lock assets. If anything blocks earlier, flag here and drop PRs into `https://git.internal/redwood/partners/nimbuskey`.
diego_partners: NimbusKey legal also asked for a joint press draft. We'll prepare a 2-paragraph joint announcement and run it through release/PR for embargo handling.
ellen_sec: I'll draft the compliance statement and architecture diagram. Expect a PR with assets and the cert rotation script by tomorrow noon.
noah_ops: I'll spin up a staging deployment and attach the demo GIF to the PR.
tara_marketing: Perfect. I'll prepare the marketplace copy + screenshots template.
maria_pm: Thanks all 44d — keep updates here.
